I picked my '18 a little less than a month ago and I'm older so i already went through the 'sport compact' phase.  The RS isn't my only car, and I picked it up used and un-modded.

Pros: good engine, good drivetrain, good power out of the box, and the car has personality. Good options like the seats, tire and wheel package.  I personally like the looks a lot and it doesn't need anything else added.  Good visibility, relatively quiet interior, and its it's a compact car so it doesn't feel bloated. It can be just a normal car or it can feel like a highly modified car at the touch of a button.

Cons: the suspension won't be for everyone, you have to drive it.  It doesn't bother me and it's not as bad as people have made it seem but it is stiff.  Same thing with the seating position, i don't think it's bad but you have to try it yourself. The fake engine noise is cheesy, and i hate the auto stop/start but it only takes a push of a button to turn it off. No blind spot monitor or self dimming rear view mirror which imo is inexcusable for a car this expensive. The center console is very small, so storage space is lacking.  The rear seats don't fold flat and you have to remove the headrests for the seats to even fold down. The back seat doesn't have a lot of leg room. No full size or donut size spare tire.

Overall i wish it had a bit more interior room and wish the interior was more refined like other Ford products (like the mustang),  but it's an older platform that they stuffed a bigger engine and an awd system into, so i do like that it's a throwback to all the other sport compact cars that have led up to it.
